title_zh: 拼多多：拼单拼出的电商平台
title_en: Chinese Companies (16/20): Pinduoduo, the Platform Built on Group Buying
note_en: To say how well or how fast something is done, Chinese puts the description after the verb, linked by 得: 拼多多的用户数量增长得非常快 "Pinduoduo's user base grew very quickly." English uses an adverb ("quickly"), but Chinese keeps the adjective 快 and lets 得 attach it to the verb 增长. Without 得, an adjective cannot simply follow the verb like this.
